message.content: The incident has been escalated to the DPO for a human decision because sources conflict on whether data was disclosed outside the controller [F03]. The severity is assessed as 5.25 (very_high) based on sensitive data categories [F02], the absence of encryption [F04], and the disclosure conflict [F03]. Under GDPR Art. 33(1) and Art. 34(1), this severity level triggers obligations to notify the supervisory authority and affected individuals. The provisional decision is to notify both the authority and the individuals.
